summary: Post-Supabase-migration verification for Meenamma. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests pass on retry (1 transient Supabase 'Server disconnected' on admin_stats when run in sequence with other tests — passes reliably in isolation). All Supabase auth (Bearer JWT via GoTrue), profiles, kudams, products (15 seeded), stats/live (catches_live=15, saved=₹340), bookings, payments create-order (deposit + server-side booking amount), payments verify rejection with fake signature, admin CRUD (products create/update/archive), admin stats/bookings/kudams/users, and admin upload (image + txt reject + non-admin 403) all validated. Frontend: Landing renders cinematic hero, Live Catch Dashboard with real values (15, ₹340), Narrative Journey chapters, no broken images. Demo login lands on /dashboard showing Sunday Feast 68% (₹340/500); new kudam creation persists to Supabase and appears immediately; session persists after reload; /market shows 15 products with tamil names + Pre-Book buttons; Admin quick-login lands on /admin with all overview stats (5 customers, 15 products, ₹340 in kudams) and all 5 tabs (Overview/Products/Orders/Kudams/Customers) visible.

minor.issue: Intermittent httpx.RemoteProtocolError 'Server disconnected' from Supabase PostgREST when called after other admin queries in the same test module. Passes reliably on retry / isolation. Consider adding a retry wrapper around sb.table(...).execute() or reusing a keep-alive httpx client to avoid PostgREST connection resets.

issues: The small tamil script glyph rendered next to 'MEENAMMA' logo appears garbled / boxes on non-landing pages (font fallback issue). Landing header renders 'மீனம்மா' correctly — likely a missing font-face import on the app shell layout. Cosmetic.

action_items: Add retry / persistent httpx client for Supabase PostgREST calls to eliminate transient 'Server disconnected' on /api/admin/stats.
Ensure Noto Sans Tamil (or equivalent) font is loaded on the authenticated layout so the small tamil glyph in the header renders correctly on Dashboard/Market/Admin.
Cosmetic: React Router v6 future-flag warnings still present in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 611 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth.py, kudams.py, payments.py, admin.py).
decode_token() falls back to sb.auth.get_user(token) for HS256 legacy tokens on every request — this is a network call. Fine for now but adds latency; JWKS ES256 path is fast.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex=r'https?://.*' with allow_credentials=True — this is essentially 'allow all origins with credentials'. For production, tighten to the actual preview + prod domains.

apply_kudam_deposit() reads then writes to kudams with no transaction/optimistic-lock; concurrent deposits could race and lose an increment. Consider using a Postgres function/RPC for atomic increment.
product_out returns only media[0].url — no fallback if media has objects without 'url' key; guarded already but consider a default placeholder image.
No pagination on /admin/bookings, /admin/kudams, /admin/users (limit 500) — will break UX past that many rows.
Payment verify path (line 320) not shown here but must strictly enforce razorpay signature — kept in scope as verified via fake-signature test (returns 400).
